input.goal: Add 300ml of water and 1tbsp of lemon juice followed by the drained basmati rice and fry on a slightly high flame for 2 to 3 minutes. Mix gently to evenly coat the rice with the cooked masala.

sub_goals.text: Prepare the measuring jug and tumbler
Fill the measuring jug with water
Add water to the pressure cooker
Extract and add lemon juice to the pressure cooker
Stir the contents and adjust the heat
Add basmati rice to the pressure cooker
Mix the rice with the masala

skills.object_recognition: L1: which object is in hand / being handled at the moment of the event
skills.spatial_near: L1: at the moment of the event, which of the listed objects is nearest to a reference object (3D positions from the dataset)
skills.spatial_side: L1: at the moment of the event, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost from the wearer's viewpoint
skills.object_location_at_time: L1: on which surface / fixture / container an object is put down at the event
skills.object_grounding: L1: localise the object of the event in a frame (bounding box)
skills.action_recognition: L2: what action (verb + object) the event is
skills.event_object_role: L2: which object is acted on, with which tool, to which destination in the event
skills.action_temporal_order: L2: the order of two actions shown close together inside one sub-goal
skills.sound_action_binding: L2: which action / object produced the sound heard
skills.object_state_change: L2: where an object was taken from and where it went in one movement

l3_relation_types.object_continuity: the same object / ingredient appears in an event of sub-goal k and an event of the ADJACENT sub-goal k+1; what happened to it between them (chopped broccoli -> in the pan)
l3_relation_types.state_change: how the state of an object differs between the two events (whole -> chopped, empty -> full, raw -> browned)
l3_relation_types.causal_prerequisite: the earlier event is a physical prerequisite of the later one (could not be done without it)
l3_relation_types.hidden_state: an appliance / container state was set in the earlier event and is not visible in the later segment; what is its state at the end of the later segment
l3_relation_types.spatial_end_state: after placements in the two events, which listed object ends nearest / farthest to a reference object (needs 3D records)

plan.goal: Add 300ml of water and 1tbsp of lemon juice followed by the drained basmati rice and fry on a slightly high flame for 2 to 3 minutes. Mix gently to evenly coat the rice with the cooked masala.

events.description: The measuring jug is placed on the counter.
events.relevance: prepares the container needed to measure the water

events.description: The tumbler is placed on the counter.
events.relevance: prepares an additional container for the task

events.description: Water is poured into the measuring jug.
Sound of water running and splashing into the jug.
events.relevance: indicates the jug is being filled

events.description: Water is poured from the measuring jug into the pressure cooker.
events.relevance: adds the measured water to the cooking vessel

events.description: Lemon juice is squeezed from a lemon half into the pressure cooker.
events.relevance: adds the required lemon juice to the mixture

events.description: The liquid and masala in the pressure cooker are stirred with a spatula.
events.relevance: mixes the newly added water and lemon juice with the base

events.description: The stove knob is turned to adjust the heat.
events.relevance: sets the flame to slightly high for frying the rice

events.description: Drained basmati rice is poured from a bowl into the pressure cooker.
events.relevance: introduces the main ingredient to the cooker

events.description: The rice and masala are gently mixed together with a spatula.
events.relevance: evenly coats the rice with the cooked masala

events.description: Sizzling and bubbling sound from the pressure cooker.
events.relevance: indicates the rice is frying on the high flame

relations.ask: What container is being filled with water?
relations.answer_hint: The measuring jug that was placed on the counter in the previous step.

relations.ask: Where did the water being poured into the pressure cooker come from?
relations.answer_hint: The measuring jug was just filled with water.

relations.ask: What liquid is already in the pressure cooker when the lemon is squeezed?
relations.answer_hint: Water was poured into the cooker in the immediately preceding step.

relations.ask: What is the heat level of the stove while the rice is being added?
relations.answer_hint: The stove knob was turned to adjust the heat to a slightly high flame just before adding the rice.

relations.ask: What ingredient is being coated with the masala?
relations.answer_hint: The drained basmati rice that was just poured into the pressure cooker.

decision_points.why: The person must decide to transition from preparing the containers to actively filling the jug with the correct amount of water.
The person must decide to move the filled jug to the stove and pour it into the cooker.
The person must decide to switch ingredients from water to lemon juice.
The person must decide to mix the liquids and adjust the stove heat before proceeding to the next ingredient.
The person must decide that the liquid base is ready and it is time to add the drained rice.
Mixing the rice immediately after adding it is a natural continuation to prevent clumping and ensure even coating, not a new strategic decision.
The person must decide that the rice is evenly coated and has fried for the required 2 to 3 minutes, concluding the task.
